name: Shader Upscale for Vestra Player
author: zysilm
punchline: Real-time AI upscaling of the video with mpv GLSL shaders: Anime4K and ArtCNN
description: Sharpens and enlarges the video on the GPU while it plays, with neural-network shaders for mpv bundled in the plugin: Anime4K (six modes, Fast or HQ) and ArtCNN (two sizes, neutral, denoise and sharpen, or denoise and soften). Video ▸ Shader Upscaling… opens a window to choose the model and its parameters, turn upscaling on and off, and see what is applied. Needs GPU rendering: macOS, or Windows with Video ▸ GPU Rendering (Experimental); ArtCNN needs Windows. Remembers your choice.
